subject: Request: Demo & Pricing — Fluxoria
messages:
From: Amy Li <amy@fluxoria.com>
To: pricing@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Demo & Pricing — Fluxoria

Hi Redwood team,

I submitted a request via your pricing page CTA — Fluxoria is evaluating LLM inference vendors for a 6–12 month POC. We have a clear budget range (roughly $15k–$30k/mo) and strong throughput requirements. Would like a product demo and a quick run-through of pricing tiers and any trial credits.

Quick details:
- Use case: real-time summarization + conversational assistant for support
- Expected QPS: burst to 40 requests/sec, typical 10–12
- Data sensitivity: PII redaction required; SOC2 is mandatory

Availability for next week: Tue/Wed afternoons (PST). Attaching a short RFP summary.

Thanks,
Amy Li
Head of Operations
Fluxoria

Attachment: Fluxoria-RFP.pdf (pdf)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Amy Li <amy@fluxoria.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Demo & Pricing — Fluxoria

Hi Amy — thanks for the submission and the RFP. I’m Mina on the growth team; happy to help coordinate. I’ve looped in Jonas (SDR) to book a 30–45m demo and Ben (solutions) to cover architecture/pricing. Monica from CS is cc’d for SOC2/retention questions if needed.

Jonas — can you propose a couple of slots next Tue/Wed PST? We have a standard 30m demo + 15m deep-dive option if they want SE time.

Amy — two quick asks so we can tailor the demo: 1) Do you need a Private deployment or is hosted acceptable for the POC? 2) Any specific models/latency SLOs we should prioritize?

I’ve attached a one-pager intro as requested.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Growth — Redwood Inference

Attachment: intro-deck.pdf (pdf)

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the quick reply.

Unfortunately we just confirmed an all-hands offsite Tue morning → late afternoon, so the Tue slots won’t work. Wed looks better but we need to check two things:

1) Our exec (based in EST) prefers late afternoon ET (which is morning PT). Can you do Wed Aug 5 at 11:30 AM PT / 2:30 PM ET?
2) Can you confirm whether hosted inference with private network peering (VPC) is acceptable, or whether we need a fully private on-prem deployment for the POC? The RFP lists SOC2 and encryption at rest as must-haves.

We also attached a short internal cost template (ops@fluxoria.com).

Thanks — if Wed 11:30 AM PT works I can lock it on our side.

—Amy

Hi Amy — Ben here (SE). Wed Aug 5 at 11:30 AM PT / 2:30 PM ET works for us; I’ve created a calendar invite and included a short pre-demo checklist so we can tailor the session:

Pre-demo checklist (please send before the call):
- Example payloads (anonymized)
- Target latency SLO in ms
- Any compliance constraints beyond SOC2

I’m also attaching our pricing-sheet v3 which maps baseline costs for hosted vs dedicated vs private deployments and highlights burst/commit options. Hosted with VPC peering is a common POC pattern and should meet your needs if you don’t need on-prem hardware isolation — Monica (cc) can confirm compliance controls for encryption and retention.

If everything looks good I can include a small trial agreement (DocuSign link below) that covers a capped trial commit — quick to sign and we can provision capacity.

DocuSign (trial): https://app.docusign.com/FLX-trial
Attachment: pricing-sheet-v3.pdf (pdf)

See you Wed — calendar invite sent.

Best,
Ben Carter
